title: Lakebase snapshots and backup schedule APIs are generally available
body: The Lakebase snapshots API and backup schedule API are now generally available. Use the snapshots API to create, get, list, and delete point-in-time snapshots, and restore a snapshot by creating a new branch from it. Use the backup schedule API to read and set a root branch's automated snapshot cadences. See [Snapshots](/aws/en/oltp/projects/snapshots).
